title: Yamanige Ganda
desc: An error grants Naresh eternal life, prompting him to assist deities in numerous missions. However, when he develops feelings for Lord Yama's daughter, he incurs the wrath of the death god.

title: Aparichita
desc: A writer visits his friend's village after he learns about his disappearance. On visiting the place, he discovers that the latter was murdered.

title: Kotee
desc: In the corrupt city of Janatha, Kotee, an honest man, defies the ruthless criminal Dinoo Savarkar in a bid to secure a better future for his sister. However, his defiance leads to overwhelming debts.

title: Acharya
desc: On behalf of an idyllic temple town, Acharya takes up the cudgels against a tyrant whose greedy sights are set on the local natural resources.

title: Aajay
desc: Ajay, a kabaddi player, hides Padma from Veerabhadra, a gangster who wants to force her into marrying him. Soon, the two fall in love.
